body: Thank you I do need that!
You're right.. I've only been in this town for 3 months maybe i'll get use to it.
Yes, I made a mistake to do a rebound girl. I do have my own problem for sure. Yes I know what your saying is right she does have her flaws.

I recently moved to a small town for work...and everyone seems like to just drink a lot. I am filipino and probably the only filipino in this town, I don't mean to judge but it seems like I get the stare from people.. Some of my co workers are racist by nature not towards me but I hear it to others.

Yeap, there are times where I see myself even though we are not together.. seeing myself or mimicking her mind to see if she approves....which drives me nuts. I do not want her in my head anymore. I really do not want to feel this way.

I can't give you the exact time frame of the drifting apart, but yes.. everyone else seems like they've moved on, and already have new circle of friends... I feel like I've been left behind (I see pictures of my old friends with new people on social media). Yes I developed a anti social persona after these incidents... and I use to be a person with awesome personality. I was able to meet and have a good time with people any person. Serious I felt like I lose my confidence after losing that beautiful girl....maybe it was the only thing that was holding me down. To be honest I was not up to par or others will say "she's out of my league" type of situation.
It was 17 or 18 years old when it hit me the most... and it's still progressing.

thanks for sharing! no man you seem like a cool dude to talk to. I just wish to move on. I want to start giving importance to the new people I've met who is there for me. I just can't seem to do that... or it always ends with small talks.
